content: Prisma: adding a new enum + enum-typed column to an existing model is a normal additive migration (prisma migrate dev) as long as the column has a default or the table has no existing rows; the tricky 'expand and contract' pattern only applies when CHANGING/REMOVING enum values already in use by existing rows (AlterEnum ordering issues, 'new enum values must be committed before use'). Kurzly's Domain table currently has no hostname/status data yet, so a straightforward additive migration is safe.
